description: Equity-tranche return metrics: IRR, MOIC, NAV and cash-on-cash.

cash_on_cash.description: Each distribution as a fraction of `invested`, by payment date.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code of the currency the amounts are denominated in.

invested.description: Cash invested on the valuation date: current balance × purchase price.

irr.description:
Annualized IRR of `−invested` on the valuation date against every
projected distribution (XIRR); `None` when no rate solves.

moic.description: Multiple on invested capital: total distributions ÷ `invested`.

nav_pct.description:
Present value of the distributions on the deal's discount curve, as a
percent of the equity's current balance.

title: EquityMetrics
